verdict.rationale: Trilegal has a dedicated IP practice page explicitly covering trademarks, copyrights, patents, designs and trade secrets, including high-stakes trademark litigation/enforcement and an IP diligence example, which satisfies the 'own practice/team' and enforcement elements of the story. Missing for 10: explicit mention of trademark clearance/prosecution and registration services (only litigation/enforcement and diligence are detailed, not the filing/registration workflow).
